oath.rings.green.1: In darkest hour and fiercest fight,
oath.rings.green.2: My will burns on, a steady light.
oath.rings.green.3: No fear shall break me, none shall stay,
oath.rings.green.4: Beware my power: green lights the way!
oath.rings.yellow.1: Let terror rise in every heart,
oath.rings.yellow.2: Let courage crack and fall apart.
oath.rings.yellow.3: Your fears take shape in golden light,
oath.rings.yellow.4: Beware the yellow, lord of night!
oath.rings.red.1: With burning blood and fury bright,
oath.rings.red.2: My rage ignites the endless fight.
oath.rings.red.3: No mercy given, none to plead,
oath.rings.red.4: The crimson flame is all I need!
oath.rings.blue.1: When all is lost and stars grow dim,
oath.rings.blue.2: Hope lights the dark from deep within.
oath.rings.blue.3: Hold fast, my friends, the dawn will come:
oath.rings.blue.4: The blue light shines till night is done!
oath.rings.orange.1: What's mine is mine, and mine alone,
oath.rings.orange.2: Each prize I take becomes my own.
oath.rings.orange.3: I'll claim the stars, I'll claim the sea:
oath.rings.orange.4: The orange light belongs to me!
oath.rings.pink.1: For hearts alone and lost in night,
oath.rings.pink.2: For love that's worth the hardest fight,
oath.rings.pink.3: I'll hold you close and set you free:
oath.rings.pink.4: The pink light shines for all to see!
oath.rings.white.1: From every root and every seed,
oath.rings.white.2: From every heart in every need,
oath.rings.white.3: Life rises up where light is spread:
oath.rings.white.4: Where white light shines, no hope is dead!
oath.rings.black.1: All flames go out, all hearts grow cold,
oath.rings.black.2: All stories end, all songs are told.
oath.rings.black.3: From silent dark the dead arise:
oath.rings.black.4: The black light closes living eyes.
death.attack.rings.energy_bolt: %1$s was blasted by an energy bolt
message.rings.no_claims: Your ring hasn't claimed anything yet. Defeat creatures to claim them
message.rings.too_many_thralls: You can't call up any more

screen.rings.suits_note: Worn whenever your ring is on
tooltip.rings.green.power: Ring power: a burst of will that throws back everything near
tooltip.rings.green.gift: Will: constructs cost a quarter less
tooltip.rings.yellow.power: Ring power: a wave of terror that sends creatures fleeing
tooltip.rings.yellow.gift: Fear: hostile creatures that come close panic
tooltip.rings.red.gift: Rage: stronger, but the ring's armor is halved
tooltip.rings.blue.power: Ring power: heal everyone near you
tooltip.rings.blue.gift: Hope: green rings near you don't run down
tooltip.rings.orange.power: Ring power: call up copies of creatures you've claimed
tooltip.rings.orange.gift: Greed: creatures you defeat are claimed by the ring
tooltip.rings.pink.power: Ring power: trap a creature in crystal and charm it
tooltip.rings.pink.gift: Love: sneak and use the ring power to go to a friend
tooltip.rings.white.power: Ring power: bring back a player who just died near you, or heal
tooltip.rings.white.gift: Life: you slowly heal while the ring is on
tooltip.rings.black.power: Ring power: drain the life of everything near you
tooltip.rings.black.gift: Death: what you kill rises as a Black Lantern to fight for you
message.rings.battery_charged: The Central Power Battery fills %s with light
message.rings.parallax_free: %s's yellow ring has set Parallax free from the Central Power Battery!
message.rings.parallax_feeds: Parallax feeds on fear: your yellow light can't touch it
message.rings.parallax_defeated: Parallax has been defeated, and fear's hold is broken
message.rings.nekron_rises: The black light %s gathered on the Moon has woken Nekron, lord of the dead!
message.rings.nekron_deathless: Death can't kill death: your black light can't touch Nekron
message.rings.nekron_defeated: Nekron has fallen, and the dead rest once more
guardian.rings.1: We are the Guardians of the Universe. Welcome to Oa, ring-bearer.
guardian.rings.2: The Central Power Battery holds the light of every lantern. Lay your hand on it and any ring is made whole.
guardian.rings.3: Long ago we sealed Parallax, fear itself, inside the Battery. Never let a yellow ring touch it.
guardian.rings.4: Beware the Manhunters. We built them to keep the peace, and now they hunt ring-bearers between the worlds.
guardian.rings.5: On the dead Moon, Nekron sleeps. Fill a black ring at a black lantern there, and he will wake.
guardian.rings.6: White light is life itself. Against Nekron, it burns three times as bright.
guardian.rings.7: Each colour of the spectrum is a feeling: will, fear, rage, hope, greed, love, life and death.
guardian.rings.8: A ring that loses its bearer will seek out another. Be worthy of the one you wear.
message.rings.shard_no_ring: Wear a ring to charge it with the shard
screen.rings.skills_xp: %s / %s ring experience to the next level
screen.rings.skills_max: Your ring can grow no further
screen.rings.skills_base: Wear your ring, fly, fight, build and charge it to grow stronger
skill.rings.soaring.desc: Sprint forward while flying to switch into the ring's elytra mode, flying where you look at 30 blocks a second.
skill.rings.super_flight.desc: In elytra mode, hold sneak to blast off, building up to 50 blocks a second.
skill.rings.sonic.desc: Super flight goes on up to 80 blocks a second, breaking the sound barrier.
skill.rings.spacefarer.desc: Fly up out of the sky into space and on to the planets. Until then your ring can't break out of the Earth's sky (though a construct jet can carry you).
skill.rings.focused_beam.desc: The beam hits for 2 hearts instead of 1¼.
skill.rings.annihilator.desc: The beam hits for 4½ hearts and sets what it hits alight.
skill.rings.spectrum.desc: Your ring colour's own power, on the ring power key (C).
skill.rings.spectrum_mastery.desc: The colour's power costs 40% less charge and reaches half as far again.
skill.rings.shaper.desc: Constructs: the dome, the cage and the giant hammer, and the axe, pickaxe and shovel.
skill.rings.armory.desc: Constructs: the sword, with its flying slash, and the shield.
skill.rings.living_light.desc: Constructs: the wolf and the golem, creatures of light that fight for you.
skill.rings.enduring.desc: Walls, bridges, stairs, domes, cages and construct creatures last twice as long.
skill.rings.starship.desc: Construct: the jet, which seats four and flies to space.
skill.rings.matter.desc: Make any item out of the ring's light, from the eye in the middle of the construct wheel.
skill.rings.hard_light_skin.desc: The ring's armor goes from +4 to +8, with +2 toughness.
skill.rings.guardian_angel.desc: A hit that would kill you is stopped, for a quarter of the ring's charge.
skill.rings.fortress.desc: The ring's armor goes to +12, with +4 toughness, and you're knocked back half as far.
skill.rings.force_field.desc: Put up a force field round you with the force field key (B). It takes hits for you, out of the ring's charge.
skill.rings.bubbles.desc: Look at a creature or player and press the force field key to carry them along in a bubble.
skill.rings.aegis.desc: The force field and bubbles take hits for half the charge.
skill.rings.scan.desc: Scan what's round about with the scan key (Z): creatures through walls, ores through rock.
skill.rings.deep_scan.desc: The scan finds creatures 80 blocks off and ores 28 blocks away.
skill.rings.efficiency.desc: Everything the ring does uses a quarter less charge.
skill.rings.willpower.desc: Everything the ring does uses half the charge.
skill.rings.lantern_bond.desc: Lanterns charge your ring twice as fast.
message.rings.needs_skill: Your ring hasn't learned that yet: %s (skill tree, K)
message.rings.veteran: Your ring remembers you: you start at ring level %s. Press K to spend your skill points.
message.rings.level_up: Your ring grows stronger: ring level %s. You have %s skill point(s) to spend on the skill tree (K).
suit.rings.locked_pilot: Take a ring from a dying ring-bearer to unlock
ship.rings.proximity: Proximity alert. Life form approaching. Pilot condition: critical. Ring search: in progress.
ship.rings.pilot_lost: Pilot life signs lost. The ring of %s has passed to its new bearer. Distress beacon off.
pilot.rings.call: Over here... please. I don't have long.
pilot.rings.call_ringed: You... wear a ring already. Come, then. Hear me.
message.rings.pilot_passing: %s is passing. Let them go in peace.
message.rings.pilot_has_ring: You already wear a ring. This one must find another bearer.
message.rings.ring_chose_you: %s has chosen you. Wear it in the ring slot, charge it at its lantern, and press K to see what it can become.
message.rings.crash_seen: A burning ship is streaking down out of the sky!
message.rings.crash_landed: It came down to the %s, about %s blocks away. Follow the smoke.
guardian.rings.no_ring: No ring is ever given, child. A ring passes only from a dying bearer to one it judges worthy. Watch the skies of your world.
dialogue.rings.pilot.start: You came... The ring searched this whole world for someone, and it led you to me. Good. There is so little time.
dialogue.rings.pilot.who: I am %1$s, of the %2$s Lantern Corps. For a hundred lifetimes of your kind we have kept the peace between the stars. My watch... is ending.
dialogue.rings.pilot.corps: Thousands of us, each the guardian of a sector of space, each chosen by a ring. We answer to the Guardians on Oa, at the heart of everything. One day you may stand there.
dialogue.rings.pilot.crash: Something came out of the dark between the stars and struck my ship. I fell through your sky like a stone. The ship will not fly again... and nor will I.
dialogue.rings.pilot.enemy: I don't know what it was. Something old, and hungry. It is still out there. You will need to be ready.
dialogue.rings.pilot.help: No. Nothing on your world can mend what was done to me. Don't waste what time I have. Listen to me.
dialogue.rings.pilot.ring: This ring is the most powerful weapon in the universe: power given shape by the %2$s light. And it chose you. Will you take it?
dialogue.rings.pilot.why: It looks into the heart. It doesn't choose the strong; it chooses those who can become strong. It saw that in you.
dialogue.rings.pilot.power: Flight. Armor of light. A beam that breaks stone. Anything you can imagine, made real out of its light... in time.
dialogue.rings.pilot.grow: In time, yes. It starts small, as you do. Wear it, fly, fight, build, and it grows with you, and you choose where each step leads. (Press K.)
dialogue.rings.pilot.lantern: Take my lantern too. When the ring runs low, hold it out to the lantern and speak the oath, and it will be made whole.
dialogue.rings.pilot.unworthy: Every bearer has said those words. I said them, a very long time ago. Be braver than your fear.
dialogue.rings.pilot.taken: There... It's yours now, and the lantern with it. Wear it on your finger, and remember: it is only as strong as you are.
dialogue.rings.pilot.farewell: Protect them. Your world... all of them... Be worthy of the light...
dialogue.rings.pilot.has_ring: You... already wear a ring. Then mine is not for you. It will wait for another.
dialogue.rings.pilot.who_ringed: I am %1$s, of the %2$s Lantern Corps. If you ever reach Oa... tell them I held on as long as I could.
dialogue.rings.pilot.option.lantern: How do I keep it charged?
dialogue.rings.ship_log.start: FLIGHT RECORDER of the ship of %1$s, %2$s Lantern Corps. Hull integrity: 11%%. Pilot: critical. Select an entry.
dialogue.rings.ship_log.entry_1: Entry 1. Routine patrol of the sector. An energy reading out past this system's gas giant, unlike anything on record. Going to look.
dialogue.rings.ship_log.entry_2: Entry 2. Attacked. Shields gone, main drive gone. Making for the nearest world with air. Inhabited... young... promising.
dialogue.rings.ship_log.entry_3: Entry 3. Crash landing. The pilot is badly hurt. The ring has begun searching this world for a successor, as rings do when their bearer is dying.
dialogue.rings.ship_log.beacon: Distress beacon broadcasting on all Corps frequencies. Distance to Oa: very great. Estimated response time: too late.
dialogue.rings.ship_log.after: FLIGHT RECORDER of the ship of %1$s, %2$s Lantern Corps. Hull integrity: 11%%. Pilot: no life signs. Select an entry.
dialogue.rings.ship_log.final: Final entry. The ring has passed to a native of this world. The pilot's last words were for them. Beacon off. Recorder closing.

first.rings.battery: First charge at the Central Power Battery! +%s ring experience

message.rings.oa_light: Oa: in the light of the Central Power Battery, your ring earns twice the experience here. The Guardians have work for those who ask.
message.rings.devourer_comes: Something vast and hungry comes out of the dark between the stars. It has found %s.
message.rings.devourer_defeated: The Devourer is destroyed. The stars are a little safer tonight.
message.rings.lantern_attuned: %s is attuned to the whole spectrum: it charges a ring of any colour now (others at half speed)
mission.rings.moonstone: Bring me %s moonstone, from the Moon
mission.rings.mars_crystals: Bring me %s Mars crystals, from the geodes and caves of Mars
mission.rings.will_shards: Bring me %s will shards, from the rock of Oa
mission.rings.nekron: Defeat Nekron, who sleeps on the Moon
mission.rings.devourer: Destroy the Devourer, the hunger between the stars
dialogue.rings.guardian.start: Ring-bearer. You stand on Oa, at the heart of the Corps, and in the light of the Battery your ring grows twice as fast. Speak, and we will listen.
dialogue.rings.guardian.no_ring: No ring is ever given, child. A ring passes only from a dying bearer to one it judges worthy. Watch the skies of your world.
dialogue.rings.guardian.respec_ask: To unmake all you have learned costs eight will shards. Every skill point returns to you, to spend again. Is that your will?
dialogue.rings.guardian.respec_done: It is done. Your ring is as new, though you are not. Choose more wisely, ring-bearer.
dialogue.rings.guardian.respec_poor: You carry too few will shards. Bring %3$s, from the rock of Oa.
dialogue.rings.guardian.respec_nothing: You have learned nothing yet that could be unmade.
dialogue.rings.guardian.mission_new: There is work. %3$s. Return to any of us when it is done, and the Corps will reward you: %4$s.
dialogue.rings.guardian.mission_none: You have no task from us. Ask, and we will give you one.
dialogue.rings.guardian.mission_done: Well done. The Corps is stronger for it. (+%3$s ring experience%4$s)
dialogue.rings.guardian.option.lore: Tell me of Oa and the Corps
dialogue.rings.guardian.option.work: Is there work for the Corps?
dialogue.rings.guardian.option.respec: I would unlearn what I have learned

duel.rings.busy: One of you is in a duel already

duel.rings.draw: The duel is over: a draw

message.rings.korugar: Korugar: the violet world, home of the yellow light. The Fortress of Fear stands at its heart, and its battery fills only yellow rings.
message.rings.fear_battery_rejects: The Fear Battery recoils from %s, and fear floods into you
first.rings.korugar: First steps on Korugar! +%s ring experience
message.rings.emergency: Your ring's last light lowers you gently, and keeps you breathing for a minute. Get to a lantern!
codex.rings.page_progress: %s of %s found. Finish the page for %s ring experience
corps.rings.no_ring: You need a ring to found a Corps
corps.rings.already: You're in a Corps already (/corps leave to go)
corps.rings.bad_name: That name is taken, or longer than %s letters
corps.rings.created: You founded the %s Corps. /corps invite <player> to recruit
corps.rings.not_leader: Only the Corps' leader can do that
corps.rings.you_invited: %s invites you to the %s Corps: /corps join %2$s
corps.rings.kicked: You were removed from the %s Corps
dialogue.rings.guardian.option.roll: Who are the greatest of the Corps?
dialogue.rings.guardian.bounty_new: Today's bounty, the same for every ring-bearer: %3$s. Do it and the reward is doubled: %4$s.
dialogue.rings.guardian.bounty_done_toda: You have claimed today's bounty already. Come back tomorrow.

mission.rings.escort_moon: Carry a living creature to the Moon in one of your bubbles

screen.rings.constructs_tip: How your hard light looks: solid, a frame or a ghost (needs Shaper)
explorer.rings.call: Over here! My ship's gone and my air won't last. Can you get me home to the Earth?
screen.rings.emblem_tip: The emblem on your suit's chest (others than the lantern from ring level 15)
command.rings.ruins_planet: Ruins are only on the Moon (shrines) or Mars (wrecks)
